stem: A grower wants a single isolation-distance number that guarantees no cross-pollination. What is the strongest response?
choices: Explain that isolation reduces risk but cannot guarantee zero pollen arrival because dispersal depends on source strength, weather and landscape
Assume neighboring production has no effect beyond one kilometer
Use the same distance for every breeding and seedless-flower goal
rationale: Cannabis pollen dispersal has a declining but nonzero tail, so risk management should match local conditions and the consequence of unintended pollination.
